title.narrative: Creating a dialogue space in cross-border communities living in Nyundo (Rwanda) and Goma (DRC) dioce

description.narrative:
TThe project aims to contribute to a good coexistence without mistrust and violence for cross-border communities living in Cyangugu and Goma dioceses. 2016 and 2017 will be the general electoral year in DRC and Rwanda and project plans to improve peaceful cohabitation within cross-border communities (especially church leaders, youths and women) when running electoral process through trainings on responsible citizenship and good electoral practices, as well as sensitization on no violence and respect of Human Rights. Project intends to a good coexistence and good election in which people participate without political manipulation that could lead to violence. It also intends to set up a framework for cooperation and exchange for cross-border communities to enable them to break the mistrust and suspicion. Masses for peace will be planned by Church leaders (priests) from Goma and Nyundo to maintain this coexistence and initiatives for behaviours and attitudes changes especially for youths will be encouraged by the project. Basic ecclesial communities in Nyundo diocese will be trained on conflict management to resolve interpersonal conflicts.
Activities will be implemented in the Nyundo Diocese located to the west of the Republic of Rwanda and in the city of Goma and its surroundings. In Goma diocese, project plans to work only with the three border parishes: Holy Spirit, St. Joseph and Rugari.
